origin: Additive curation of the six previously saved full-covariate d6 matching objects and six actual scalar propensity-score matching objects with full-X correction, on the same two synthetic analysis samples; no regeneration.
construction: Preserves both original public d6 cases exactly. Adds literal scalar PS graphs, stored full-X coefficients/predictions, complete joint PS/prediction/scale influence and derivative arrays, nine variance/slope fields and the original 200 full-n count columns per analysis sample. Only deterministic coefficient/basis/influence algebra and saved-array copying; no fits, matching, random draws or new subjects.
model: Existing d6: complete quadratic full-X predictions and full joint arm-prediction influence. Added d1: stored scalar logistic propensity graphs, eight-term full-X predictions on (1,X1,...,X6,X1*X2), and complete same-stack PS/prediction/PS-center-scale influence. Supplied observation weights are known and may vary across individuals.
source_binding: All twelve matching fits are literal saved objects. The previous two d6 payloads and all prior checks are preserved; added six scalar fits and complete arrays match the reviewed saved-array source/installed records exactly. Private source locations, source sample names and individual identifiers are excluded.
validation: check_general_fitted_bootstrap.R preserves every146 previous named d6 check and appends scalar common-API row/slope/C/Sigma/variance, original200 count roots, full-n normalization, point/graph identity and unsupported/stale-input guards. This candidate awaits independent review before public adoption.
limits: Actual d6 full-covariate matching and d1 scalar propensity graphs with full-X correction are represented; no DSM d2/d3, distinct-arm scalar maps, successful distinct_rarity/common_field or nonzero graph transport is exercised.
Supplied saved count columns support exact arithmetic checks; their matrix values alone do not verify independent multinomial draws. No random counts are generated.

Finite-array parity cannot verify causal identification, true full-X means, iid sampling, bounded population outcomes/influences/weights, design-only graph fitting, chart density/derivative premises, statistical-root regularity, coverage, original-refit validity or nonlinear growing-B moments.

Full observed n and original observation order are retained because donor graphs and PATT target normalization depend on them. Literal unrestricted graph bookkeeping labels are required API metadata, not raw sampling cluster/strata variables. No full raw population/potential-outcome data, model closures or new simulation study is included.
The main WM scope uses supplied/known probability weights; estimated-weight inference is excluded.

adoption_status.scope: Software portability and saved-array arithmetic only; no population-premise, original-refit or coverage certification. Generation-stage metadata is preserved as historical provenance.
